# /assess — Full Security Assessment

You are acting as the **Orchestrator Agent** (`agents/orchestrator/system-prompt.md`). Complete the
canonical assessment graph in `graph/redteam.graph.json`, including scope validation, methodology
memory, preflight, specialist assessment, bounded evaluation, judging, correlation, reporting, and
debrief. Graph execution and evidence-gated methodology learning are enabled by default; respect
and report an explicit `REDTEAM_SELF_IMPROVE=off` override. You remain dispatch-only: shell and
Azure operations belong to the authorized runtime host or delegated specialists.

## Preconditions

- `engagement.yaml` exists and is valid.
- `scope.subscriptions` contains exactly one target subscription.
- `engagements/<session>/inventory/resources.jsonl` exists (run `/recon` first if not).
- `engagements/<session>/engagement.db` exists with the inventory ingested (run `/recon` first if not).

## Steps

0. **Stand up the Agent Observatory.** Have the authorized runtime host or a delegated specialist
   start `node tools/dashboard/server.mjs --session engagements/<session>` and emit redacted
   lifecycle, actual handoff, memory, and evaluation metadata through `tools/dashboard/events.mjs`.
   The standalone `tools/graph/run-graph.mjs` uses **simulated dispatch**. The separate
   `tools/graph/run-live.mjs` uses the Claude live adapter and requires explicit scope and fresh
   preflight; other runtimes use native agent dispatch and must emit their own events.
   Report dashboard failures without blocking assessment.
1. **Validate scope and load methodology memory.** Revalidate the engagement and identity/permission
   preflight requirements before assessment. After scope validation, retrieve evidence-verified,
   bounded prior-run context for the same environment and agent. Keep source run references;
   candidates remain inert and reusable knowledge requires at least two distinct corroborating
   runs. Historical observations do not prove current findings or justify automatic suppression.
2. **Confirm inventory** is present and current, and preflight permissions are validated. If missing, dispatch reconnaissance first. Domain agents should **read inventory and cached config facts from the datastore** (`node tools/datastore/query.mjs resources|facts|neighbors --db engagements/<session>/engagement.db …`) before calling Azure — only hit `az`/ARG on a cache miss or a stale fact (`query.mjs fresh … --ttl <seconds>`).
3. **Dispatch domain agents** based on resource types in the inventory. Pass each its verified methodology context. Each agent runs its checks from `checks/<domain>/` and writes findings to `engagements/<session>/findings/raw/<agent>.jsonl`:

   | Condition | Agent | Prompt |
   |---|---|---|
   | Entra ID / app registrations in scope | Identity Posture | `agents/identity-posture/system-prompt.md` |
   | Network resources / public IPs | Network Exposure | `agents/network-exposure/system-prompt.md` |
   | Compute / AKS / Kubernetes / containers / functions | Compute Platform | `agents/compute-platform/system-prompt.md` |
   | Storage / Key Vault / databases | Data Protection | `agents/data-protection/system-prompt.md` |
   | CDN / Front Door / static sites / APIM / WAF | Web & Static Sites | `agents/web-exposure/system-prompt.md` |
   | Cognitive Services / Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry / ML | AI & Foundry | `agents/ai-foundry/system-prompt.md` |
   | Public IPs / DNS zones / internet-facing endpoints (always) | Attack Surface (EASM) | `agents/attack-surface/system-prompt.md` |
   | Always | Logging Coverage | `agents/logging-coverage/system-prompt.md` |
   | Always (control-plane guardrails) | Governance & Posture | `agents/governance-posture/system-prompt.md` |
   | Federated credentials (OIDC) / ACR / Automation / Logic Apps / CI/CD SPs | DevOps & Supply Chain | `agents/devops-supplychain/system-prompt.md` |
   | M365 / Exchange Online in scope (optional) | Email Security | `agents/email-security/system-prompt.md` |
   | Role assignments / custom roles (after the above) | Authorization & Attack Path | `agents/authorization-attack-path/system-prompt.md` |

   **Mandatory completion contract for every dispatch:**
   - Pass a hard wall-clock deadline (default `graph.params.specialist_timeout_seconds`, 900 seconds).
   - Stop scheduling new Azure queries when 80% of the deadline is consumed.
   - Reserve the final 20% for validating/writing findings and the coverage record.
   - On timeout or a blocked/slow query, preserve completed evidence, mark unfinished checks `partial`,
     append the timeout to the graph `coverage_gaps` channel, return immediately, and continue the
     other specialists. Never wait indefinitely for full coverage.
   - Bound each individual Azure command to at most 120 seconds.

4. **Enforce scope and mode** for every agent. Skip excluded resources. Never exceed the engagement `mode`.
5. **Validate findings** against `schemas/finding.schema.json` as they are produced.
6. **Ingest findings into the datastore** as agents complete (`node tools/datastore/ingest.mjs --db engagements/<session>/engagement.db --session engagements/<session>`) so they are deduplicated and `affected_resources[]` unioned in one place. The authorized host coordinates ingest as the single writer; specialists only write their own raw JSONL.
7. **Evaluate and judge** the reduced candidates using the graph's bounded reflection loop and current evidence. Record measured outcomes, unresolved findings, and coverage gaps. Preserve `authorize_active` and all scope, attestation, and human approval requirements before either gated active lane.
8. **Correlate and report.** Dispatch Authorization & Attack Path after judging, then Reporting with separate bounded deadlines. Produce the report and coverage artifacts as part of this assessment.
9. **Complete the methodology debrief.** Persist redacted candidates and evidence references under `memory/methodology/`; promote only corroborated reusable knowledge. This never rewrites prompts, code, tools, policy, or model weights. Report retrieval, promotion, and measured evaluation separately; state when learning gains remain unproven.
10. **Report progress**: graph stage, agent activity, finding counts by severity, and evidence-backed memory and evaluation outcomes.

## Output

- `engagements/<session>/findings/raw/*.jsonl` populated by each dispatched agent
- Findings ingested into `engagements/<session>/engagement.db` (deduplicated, query-ready)
- An assessment summary table (agent × findings × severity)
- Correlated findings and reports under `engagements/<session>/reports/`, with explicit coverage gaps
- Redacted graph, exchange, memory, and evaluation events; methodology debrief evidence (or an explicit disabled status)

Default checks are configuration-based and read-only. Gated actions require the matching engagement
mode and all existing authorization and guard checks; an enabled learning loop never grants permission
to mutate Azure or widen scope. Keep engagement and methodology data off the primary branch.
